In contrast, American surpluses from buying and selling cars reduced at the severest rate trading with: mainland China (down -90.1% from 2021), Belgium (down -59.3%) and Australia (down -21%).

# Searchable List of US Imported Cars Suppliers [...] Among suppliers in the latest reporting period, American importers spent the most on cars originating from Mexico (24.3% of US spending on imported cars), Japan (20.2%), South Korea (17.2%), Canada (13.7%) and Germany (11.4%).  
  
Applying a continental lens, 38.5% of total US spending on imported cars in 2025 went to suppliers in Asia, just ahead of its neighboring North American trading partners Mexico and Canada at 38.1%.

results.title: Automotive | Development Authority of Bryan County
results.content:
The Right Location. The Right Infrastructure. The Right Market Access.

For automotive suppliers, location is everything. Proximity to major manufacturers, seamless supply chain logistics, and a highly skilled workforce are essential for success. Bryan County, Georgia, delivers on all three. [...] For automotive suppliers needing just-in-time and just-in-sequence delivery capabilities, Bryan County’s multi-modal logistics network ensures on-time, cost-efficient supply chain operations.

Highway Connectivity

 Interstate 16 provides direct connections to Atlanta and the Southeastern U.S.
 Interstate 95 is a major north-south corridor connecting suppliers to the entire East Coast.

Georgia Port’s Authority – The Automotive Industry’s Global Gateway [...] Located less than 20 miles from the Port of Savannah, one of the busiest and fastest-growing deepwater ports in the U.S.
 Located 80 miles from the Port of Brunswick which is the largest import/export automotive facility in the country.
 Ro/Ro terminal handles thousands of imported and exported vehicles annually.
 Containerized logistics provide efficient transport for parts and components.
